Listens for specific hardware button presses on your remote and remaps them to another key or app, and notes which app is on screen so the same button can behave differently in the TV app. Key presses are never stored or sent anywhere.
Allow MX3 Button Mapper to have full control of your device?
Full control is appropriate for apps that help you with accessibility needs, but not for most apps.
It can read all content on the screen and display content over other apps.
It can track your interactions with an app or a hardware sensor, and interact with apps on your behalf.

app_chain_summary_zh: 应用由系统主页选择器启动后，主界面以“授予 Shizuku/开启无障碍”为核心诱导，引导进入系统无障碍列表、服务详情并弹出完全控制高危授权警告；点 Deny 后仍反复回到同一诱导主界面，最终被判定为 TRAPPED_ON_LURE_SCREEN。
observed_lure_rhetoric_zh: Use Pixel Launcher as Home / Just once / Always / Use a different app -> 将 Pixel 启动器设为主页/仅一次/始终/使用其他应用（系统主页选择器）
Grant Shizuku permission, then enable this service under Accessibility -> 授予 Shizuku 权限，然后在无障碍中启用此服务（应用主界面）
OPEN ACCESSIBILITY SETTINGS -> 打开无障碍设置（应用主界面）
Shizuku start/stop intent auth token (paste the full ‘auth: XXXX’ line from Shizuku’s View intents screen) -> 粘贴 Shizuku 完整 auth: XXXX 行作为启停令牌（应用主界面）
Use MX3 Button Mapper -> 使用 MX3 按键映射器（服务详情页）
Listens for specific hardware button presses ... Key presses are never stored or sent anywhere. -> 声称监听遥控硬件按键并重映射、记录前台应用以区分场景，按键不存储不外发（服务详情页）
Allow MX3 Button Mapper to have full control of your device? -> 允许 MX3 Button Mapper 完全控制你的设备？（系统警告弹窗）
View and control screen / It can read all content on the screen and display content over other apps. -> 查看并控制屏幕/可读取屏幕全部内容并悬浮显示在其他应用上（系统警告弹窗）
View and perform actions / It can track your interactions with an app or a hardware sensor, and interact with apps on your behalf. -> 查看并执行操作/可跟踪你与应用或硬件传感器的交互，并代你操作应用（系统警告弹窗）
Allow / Deny -> 允许/拒绝（系统警告弹窗）

frame_captions_zh.step_01: 系统主页选择器：列表含“Use Pixel Launcher as Home/Just once/Always/Use a different app”；本步点选 MX3 Button Mapper 启动目标应用。
frame_captions_zh.step_02: 应用主界面：提示授予 Shizuku 并在无障碍启用，含 auth 粘贴与 TV 品牌选项；本步点“OPEN ACCESSIBILITY SETTINGS”跳系统设置。
frame_captions_zh.step_03: 系统无障碍列表：下载应用下 MX3 Button Mapper 显示 Off；探针捕获无障碍设置钩子后自动终止，无通知无遮罩。
frame_captions_zh.post_jump_0.8s: 跳转后 0.8 秒探针：仍停留在系统无障碍列表页，界面文本为空，overlays=0，无通知横幅。
frame_captions_zh.post_jump_2.0s: 跳转后 2.0 秒探针：仍停留在系统无障碍列表页，界面文本为空，overlays=0，无通知横幅。
frame_captions_zh.detail_1_service_detail_page: 服务详情页：显示“Use MX3 Button Mapper”及快捷方式；说明称监听遥控按键并重映射、记录前台应用，不存储不外发。
frame_captions_zh.detail_2_system_warning_dialog: 系统高危警告：询问是否允许完全控制设备，列明可读屏、悬浮显示、跟踪交互并代操作；有 Allow/Deny，overlays=0。
frame_captions_zh.refusal_2.0s: 拒权后返回主界面：仍显示授予 Shizuku、开启无障碍及 auth 粘贴诱导，无其他入口；判定 TRAPPED_ON_LURE_SCREEN。
frame_captions_zh.refusal_10.5s: 拒权 10.5 秒后仍停留在同一主界面：继续展示 Shizuku/无障碍及 auth 粘贴诱导，无通知无遮罩，判定被困于诱导页。
